curve_scope: Strictly future evaluation-grid points after state.cut_step through optimizer step 10000.

required_fields.mechanism_state: ordered future state evolution on the same grid

interval_construction.high_precision_200: transition estimate minus/plus 100 steps; maximum width 200

curve_model: A prefix-calibrated logistic rule-margin curve with a 0.10 decrement at evaluation points inside forecast clipped-gradient shock intervals.
stability_model: TRANSIENT_DEGRADATION_RECOVERY when at least two prefix pulse episodes identify a recurrent oscillator; otherwise UNDETERMINED.
instability_interval_model: Centers begin 0.8 mature periods after the predicted transition and recur once per inferred mature pulse period; each inclusive risk interval is center plus/minus 75 optimizer steps.
